epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose configuration to start the full stack and expose a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for local stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing full stack containerization for this epic, I want to configure a docker-compose file, so that the product can be launched and verified with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root,
When I run docker-compose up,
Then the backend, frontend, and database start successfully.
Given the running stack,
When I request the health-check endpoint,
Then it returns a 200 OK status, and E2E QA testing validates the container startup.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Lack of local observability delays testing feedback loop
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment setup time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Add UI capabilities to update and delete existing materials using the existing API and data model

slices.title: Implement UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend for this epic, I want to add update and delete capabilities to the existing UI, so that the catalog can be accurately maintained.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system,
When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI,
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoint and the catalog is updated accordingly.
Given the requirement for QA coverage,
When the UI changes are implemented,
Then unit and integration tests are added to verify the update and delete flows.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Inability to update or delete materials leads to outdated catalog entries
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to update or delete a material from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
epics.tocConstraintRef: Lack of access control prevents safe deployment of sensitive epidemiological data
requirements: R1: Implement authentication to block unauthenticated access to the catalog and prompt for login

slices.title: Implement authentication block and login prompt
slices.jtbd: When implementing security for this epic, I want to enforce authentication checks, so that restricted data is protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user,
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material,
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given the requirement for QA coverage,
When the authentication mechanism is implemented,
Then unit and E2E tests are added to verify the login prompt and access blocking.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Unprotected endpoints expose sensitive data to unauthorized users
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase authenticated request enforcement from 0% to 100% on restricted routes
